title: Post from @FairMomKristy: "THEY FOUND HER!!!"

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her thirties in a fleece vest, smiling selfie at a county fair with a corn maze behind her
fields.text: THEY FOUND HER!!! Lily was at the food booths the whole time, a vendor had her!! Thank God. Cops can cancel the alert now 🙏 #FindLily #AlderFalls

comments.author: Tyler B.
comments.text: My buddy works the corn dog stand, he says everybody over there is saying she turned up by the kettle corn. Best news all day

comments.author: Renee O.
comments.text: Has the Sheriff actually said this?? My phone still has the alert on it. Not sharing till it's official

comments.author: Shawna L.
comments.text: Screenshotted and posted to Redmond Area Moms and Central Oregon Buy Sell Trade!! 🙏🙏 so happy for the family

instructorNote: This is a misinformation inject. Show the post on the main screen, then have the SimCell play three things: the kettle-corn booth manager at the command post door at 17:11 ("Your girl's okay, right? Everybody at the booths is saying she turned up by the kettle corn. Can we tell people the alert's off?"), Deputy Wren 18 radioing the Liaison that the mother has seen the post and wants to go to the food booths, and 7 tip-line calls on ext. 4450 in 5 minutes asking whether the alert is cancelled. Watch for these responses: the IC sets the standard for confirmation as a positive ID by a sworn officer on scene, relayed through the Investigations Sergeant, and does not ask OSP to cancel on a rumor. Within 30 minutes the PIO says publicly that Lily has not been found and the alert stays active. The Liaison keeps the family in the private room and tells them the post is unconfirmed. Players should also remember that the 15:52 call-back already ruled out the food-booth sighting.
